value.rationale: Sharp computable maximum positivity-preserving step for arbitrary heterogeneous positive star networks plus a counterintuitive robust-design result: distributing conductance equally is uniquely worst for allowable step at fixed total, while extreme concentration leads to divergent allowance. Also identifies exact singular epsilon^(-1/2) frontier with nontrivial m-dependence. The proof distinguishes a degree-based CFL bound from exact positivity.
